ui.creator.title: New character
ui.creator.lead: Before you set foot in Cyrodiil, give your character a name. You choose the race, sex and looks right after, in the game's creator.
ui.creator.hint: {min} to {max} letters each. An apostrophe or a hyphen is fine, as in Ra'jirr or Gro-Malog.
ui.creator.note: The name cannot be changed later, so take your time.
